name: summary filters exposure and missing metrics only
test:
import math
rows = [{'variant':'A','exposed':True,'metric':10.0}, {'variant':'A','exposed':True,'metric':10.0}, {'variant':'B','exposed':True,'metric':15.0}, {'variant':'B','exposed':True,'metric':15.0}, {'variant':'B','exposed':False,'metric':1000.0}, {'variant':'A','exposed':True,'metric':None,'country':'US'}]
summary = ab_summary(rows)
assert math.isclose(summary['lift'], 0.5)
assert 0.0 <= summary['p_value'] <= 1.0

name: segment reports are pre-aggregated and safe for missing groups
test:
import math
rows = [{'variant':'A','exposed':True,'metric':2.,'country':'US'}, {'variant':'A','exposed':True,'metric':4.,'country':'US'}, {'variant':'B','exposed':True,'metric':6.,'country':'US'}, {'variant':'B','exposed':True,'metric':6.,'country':'US'}]
report = SegmentLiftReport(rows)
assert math.isclose(report.lift('US'), 1.0)
assert math.isnan(report.lift('CA'))

name: lift and significance have separate undefined cases
test:
import math
singleton = ab_summary([{'variant':'A','exposed':True,'metric':2.}, {'variant':'B','exposed':True,'metric':3.}])
assert math.isclose(singleton['lift'], 0.5) and math.isnan(singleton['p_value'])
zero_base = ab_summary([{'variant':'A','exposed':True,'metric':0.}, {'variant':'A','exposed':True,'metric':0.}, {'variant':'B','exposed':True,'metric':1.}, {'variant':'B','exposed':True,'metric':1.}])
assert math.isnan(zero_base['lift']) and zero_base['p_value'] == 0.0
empty = ab_summary([])
assert math.isnan(empty['lift']) and math.isnan(empty['p_value'])

name: normal-tail approximation uses sample variances and missing segments remain global
test:
import math
rows = [{'variant':'A','exposed':True,'metric':1.}, {'variant':'A','exposed':True,'metric':3.,'country':None}, {'variant':'B','exposed':True,'metric':2.}, {'variant':'B','exposed':True,'metric':6.}, {'variant':'C','exposed':True,'metric':999.}]
summary = ab_summary(rows)
assert math.isclose(summary['lift'], 1.0)
assert math.isclose(summary['p_value'], math.erfc(2.0 / math.sqrt(10.0)), rel_tol=1e-12)
assert math.isnan(SegmentLiftReport(rows).lift(None))
equal = ab_summary([{'variant':variant,'exposed':True,'metric':2.} for variant in ['A','A','B','B']])
assert equal['lift'] == 0.0 and equal['p_value'] == 1.0
